acks.detail: Task 3 — `renderMove`'s live call to the renderer: the POST to `<TINYAPP_RENDER_URL>/snapshot`, the doc-sourced `addScriptTag: [{content}]` request parameter, and the `REFLECT_CHECKED` script that writes `data-checked` before serialisation (`packages/tinyapp-exam/src/render-move.ts:170-174, 248-258`). — Structurally complete and fully exercised against an injected `fetchImpl`, but no real endpoint is ever dialled: every test passes the placeholder `http://renderer.invalid/v4/accounts/x/browser-rendering` and a stub response. Whether Cloudflare Browser Rendering honours `addScriptTag: [{content}]` on `/snapshot` — and therefore whether `checked`/`unchecked` views can ever hold live — is doc-sourced and unverified, which the plan itself records as what §7 asked Plan A to leave for the first run. [structural false-green: sandbox could not execute it against the target]

Task 3 + Task 6 — the rendered snapshot page end to end: `renderHtml`'s inlined bundle plus seed script actually booting the app in a browser and painting `#todoList`/`.todoItem`, which is what the two first-run exams' `view` entries assert (`tests/state-exams/buy-milk.test.ts:15-18`, `tests/state-exams/empty-todo-refused.test.ts:15-18`). — The suite runs both exams with `ULTRA_RUN_DIR` unset, so their render move records `skipped` and only the store and mutant moves are proven — `$ bun test tests/state-exams/buy-milk.test.ts tests/state-exams/empty-todo-refused.test.ts` exits 0 with both passing on that basis. The seeded page's no-persister/no-synchronizer behaviour is separately executed under happy-dom in `client/test/seeded-store.test.ts`; what remains unexecuted is a real browser loading the inlined bundle and the view selectors matching its painted DOM.
